tasks.title: Atomic root noindex shell
tasks.end_state: An atomic code-owned noindex root shell renders at / with approved identity copy only. SeoHead (typed props: title, description, canonicalPath?, noindex) renders canonical via canonicalHref(canonicalPath ?? Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site.href) and noindex meta. BaseLayout provides the html shell, head via SeoHead, a skip link to #main, one <main id=main>, and <slot />. index.astro renders the approved identity title/description, one h1, noindex, and uses BaseLayout. The verifier CLI manifest is updated to expect / as an html route (not discoverable), with allowEmptySitemap: true. No brand tokens, no global.css, no client script, no favicon, no Home Markdown record.
tasks.files_note: Declared 5-file cohesive exception: the atomic root activation requires the page, the shared SeoHead/BaseLayout, the verifier manifest update, and the new test file to land in one GREEN boundary so every gate passes. Approved per .opencode/command/plan.md:340-373.

Commit: test(m2): define root noindex shell contract

GREEN: npm run check exit 0; npm test exit 0; npm run build exit 0; npm run verify exit 0; dist/index.html has exactly one canonical https://example.com/, one noindex meta, one h1, skip link to #main, no <script>; dist still has sitemap.xml + robots.txt only besides index.html. Commit: feat(m2): atomic root noindex shell

tasks.title: No-JavaScript header and footer
tasks.end_state: SiteHeader renders one always-visible <nav aria-label=Primary> tree (no details/summary, no JS toggle). It calls getEntry('settings','site') for labels (missing record throws and fails the build; no silent fallback), getCollection('pages') to build the visibility map, resolveRoutes to keep only routable paths in NAV_ORDER, and prepends the ROOT_ROUTE link with aria-current=page on the active route. SiteFooter renders a minimal footer (no brand tokens). BaseLayout integrates header and footer with structural CSS in <style> blocks (focus-visible outlines, responsive reflow; no brand tokens, no motion). No client script.
tasks.files_note: Declared 4-file cohesive exception: the header/footer are a cohesive nav+chrome unit sharing the BaseLayout integration and one test file. Approved per .opencode/command/plan.md:340-373.
verification: RED: node --test tests/shell.test.mjs — header/footer test fails on assertion (B1 build has zero nav links / no <nav> / no footer; primary-nav count assertion fails, not ENOENT). Commit: test(m2): define no-JS shell chrome contract

Commit: feat(m2): no-JS header and footer

tasks.title: Recoverable 404 page

B3 does not modify SeoHead or BaseLayout.
